sources.title: Inland Revenue Ordinance (Cap. 112), consolidated current version — Part 4 Division 3A Specified Foreign-sourced Income (ss.15H-15S)
sources.publisher: Department of Justice, Hong Kong SAR (Hong Kong e-Legislation)
sources.notes: Primary statute, machine-readable XML (no OCR needed). Verified Division 3A map: s.15H interpretation; s.15I charging/deemed Hong Kong receipt; s.15J notification; s.15K economic-substance exception (15K(2)(a) pure equity-holding simplified test, 15K(2)(b) general test, 15K(3) definitions); s.15L IP nexus (outside dividend slice); s.15M participation exception with 15M(2) thresholds (continuously held not less than 5% for not less than 12 months); s.15N (in force 2025-06-06): 15N(2) subject-to-tax, 15N(3) anti-hybrid deduction, 15N(4) main-purpose test, 15N(5) foreign-tax credit switch-over, 15N(7) 15% reference rate (15N(8) amendable by gazette); s.15O direct/indirect investee; s.15S record-keeping. The zip bundle covers Cap.1-300 (235,917,074 bytes, sha256 e9ad65efbdd1194efbbca19d1d5f1f10ff80f9ae976f22ec1aaff4b0a0f17930); extract only cap_112_en_c.
